Nonpareil curves
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(Nonpareil)

# Load files
files <- list.files(
    "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/nonpareil",
    pattern = "\\.npo$",
    full.names = TRUE
)


# Plot nonpareil curves
png(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/nonpareil_curves.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 600
)

# Generate the Nonpareil plot while PNG device is open
nps <- Nonpareil.set(
  files,
  plot.opts = list(plot.observed = FALSE)
)

# Close PNG device
dev.off()

# Save PDF version
# Open PDF graphics device
cairo_pdf(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/pdf_figs/FigS1.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# Generate Nonpareil curves
nps <- Nonpareil.set(
  files,
  plot.opts = list(plot.observed = FALSE)
)

# Close PDF graphics device
dev.off()

# Statistics
summary(nps)
```


Exportable table for supplemental
```{r}
# Extract summary statistics
np_summary <- summary(nps)

# Convert to a data frame
np_table <- as.data.frame(np_summary)

# Add culture ID from row names
np_table <- np_table %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Culture ID") %>%
  mutate(
    `Estimated coverage percent` = C * 100,
    `Observed sequencing effort (Gbp)` = LR / 1e9,
    `Projected effort (Gbp)` = LRstar / 1e9,
    `Diversity index` = diversity,
    `Model R²` = modelR
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Culture ID`,
    `Estimated coverage percent`,
    `Observed sequencing effort (Gbp)`,
    `Projected effort (Gbp)`,
    `Diversity index`,
    `Model R²`
  )

# Round values
np_table <- np_table %>%
  mutate(
    `Estimated coverage percent` = round(`Estimated coverage percent`, 2),
    `Observed sequencing effort (Gbp)` = round(`Observed sequencing effort (Gbp)`, 2),
    `Projected effort (Gbp)` = round(`Projected effort (Gbp)`, 2),
    `Diversity index` = round(`Diversity index`, 2),
    `Model R²` = round(`Model R²`, 4)
  )

# Export
write.csv(
  np_table,
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/nonpareil_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
